run_rmac_features_extractor: run the RMAC features extractor CLI to compute video descriptors from a dataset folder
train_pca_whitening: train PCA whitening on RMAC descriptors from a dataset folder and save model files
compute_rmac_descriptors: compute RMAC features from a single video file using pre-trained PCA and save descriptors
create_video_dataset: create a VideoDataset that extracts frames from a video at a given FPS and applies image transforms
apply_pca_whitening: apply PCA whitening to RMAC descriptors by fitting on training data and transforming new descriptors
